name: Jewish Federation of Greater Atlanta

fetch.note: Event grid; calendar view at /events/?calendar. Custom WordPress (Loyal); no ICS, events are not exposed in wp-json.
RSS 2.0 of recent event posts (10 items). Gives post dates, not event dates, so use it only to discover new event URLs.

notes: Also hosts PJ Library Atlanta and JBaby events.

name: Marcus Jewish Community Center of Atlanta (MJCCA)

fetch.note: The Events Calendar ICS. It returns only the next ~30 events per request. Month view /calendar/month/2026-11/?ical=1 also works (verified).
Events Calendar REST API (JSON, paginated, about 24k total events including classes). Best for full coverage; filter out recurring classes and fitness sessions.

notes: Very high volume. Most events are recurring classes, so filter by category (book festival, arts, community-wide).

name: Jewish Family & Career Services (JF&CS)

fetch.note: Craft CMS calendar with event URLs like /calendar/event/{id}/{yyyy}/{mm}/{dd}. Sub-calendars include /calendar/community-events and /calendar/aviv-older-adults. No ICS link found.

notes: Scraping /calendar/community-events is probably the most relevant.

name: Hillels of Georgia

fetch.note: Wix site using Wix Events. Per-campus pages: /emory-events, /gsu-events, /ksu-events, /gcsu-events. No ICS feed.

notes: Wix renders server-side, so the HTML is scrapeable but heavy (~1.2MB).

name: AJC Atlanta (American Jewish Committee)

fetch.note: Regional events listing. No ICS.

notes: Major events (for example the National Human Relations Award) link out to donate.ajc.org.

name: ADL Southeast

fetch.note: Regional site (adl.org/southeast returns 404). No events feed found.
National events page; would need filtering for Atlanta/Southeast.

notes: Few public events. Facebook @ADLSoutheast may be more current. Low yield.

fetch.note: WordPress with JetEngine listing; event pages at /events/{slug}/. ?ical=1 does not work.

name: The Dupree

fetch.note: Homepage lists upcoming programs, each linking to eventcreate.com/e/{slug}. There is no /events page (404).

notes: Event details and dates are on eventcreate.com pages.

name: Atlanta Jewish Film Festival (AJFF)

fetch.note: Client-side React app. curl and WebFetch get an empty shell, so it needs a headless browser or its backing API.

notes: The main festival runs in late January and February; year-round screenings are sporadic. Consider hand-entering festival dates once a year.

name: Hadassah Greater Atlanta

fetch.note: Chapter page with an #events section. The regional list is at hadassah.org/region/southeastern.

notes: Listings are often stale. Facebook (hadassahgreateratlanta) is more active.

name: Jewish Women's Fund of Atlanta (JWFA)

fetch.note: WordPress page with no ICS.

notes: jewishwomensfund.org does not resolve; the correct domain is jwfatlanta.org.

name: Jewish Women's Connection of Atlanta (JWCA)
notes: Runs under the Atlanta Scholars Kollel. jwca.org is a parked domain (redirects to /lander) and no official site was found. Events are probably promoted by email or social media only.

name: Consulate General of Israel to the Southeast

fetch.note: News and announcements only. There is no events calendar.

notes: Public events are rare and usually co-hosted (Federation, synagogues). Global Atlanta's events calendar has an 'israel' category, but its ?ical=1 is blocked for non-browser clients. Low yield.

name: Atlanta Rabbinical Association

fetch.note: WordPress page with no ICS (?ical=1 not supported). There is also a /member-only-events/ page.

notes: atlantarabbis.org does not resolve; the correct domain is atlrabbis.org.

name: PJ Library Atlanta

fetch.note: PJ Library events are posted on the Federation events page (same source as jewish-federation-greater-atlanta).

notes: Run by the Jewish Federation of Greater Atlanta. pjlibrary.org/atlanta just redirects to enrollment. Consider merging with the Federation source and tagging PJ/JBaby events.

name: Jewish National Fund-USA Atlanta (Southeast)

fetch.note: Regional page linking to events.jnf.org/e/{slug} (for example /e/hirsch, the Breakfast for Dinner gala). No ICS.

notes: Only a few large events per year.

name: Chabad of Georgia

fetch.note: Wix site, mostly news. No ICS.

notes: Local Chabad centers (Intown, Dunwoody, Cobb and others) run their own chabad.org-platform sites, which usually expose calendars. Add them as separate sources if needed.

name: Atlanta Jewish Times / Atlanta Jewish Connector

fetch.note: Community calendar run by AJT (3,000+ events, loads more via 'Load More'). Verified with WebFetch. Cloudflare returns 403 to curl. No ICS (?ical=1 returns HTML).

notes: Cloudflare bot challenge: the weekly job needs a real browser (Playwright) or this source has to be skipped. An aggregator of the other sources, so use it for cross-checking or discovery rather than as a primary feed.

name: Ahavath Achim Synagogue

fetch.note: The Events Calendar ICS (~30 upcoming events). Verified with WebFetch. Cloudflare challenge returns 403 to plain curl.
HTML calendar (verified with WebFetch).

notes: Cloudflare blocks non-browser clients, so the fetch job may need a headless browser. Includes recurring minyanim and candle-lighting entries; filter those out.

name: The Temple (Hebrew Benevolent Congregation)

ShulCloud HTML calendar

notes: ShulCloud returns 406 unless the request sends a browser-like Accept header. Drop rows where Type='Schedule Rule' (recurring services).
